item.title: Mehler Protection Presents “Omega Jaw”: First Mandible Guard with AK47 Protection Meeting VPAM 6

item.title: Breakthrough for Seasnake: Sweden Becomes First NATO Customer
item.description: The newest NATO member, Sweden, has commissioned Rheinmetall to supply eight Seasnake 30 weapon systems for the Swedish Navy. These systems will be the primary armament of the new Combat Boat 90 fast military assault craft.
